mentions.name: Scout for LoL
mentions.description: A match tracker for League of Legends that posts notifications to Discord when a player starts or ends a game, accompanied by a generated image. All games are saved to a datalake, and users can create competitions or scheduled reports over their community's matches.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My pet project is this match tracker for League of Legends: https://scout-for-lol.com

Essentially it posts notifications to Discord when someone starts/ends a game with a pretty image.
mentions.author: shepherdjerred
